title: SIEVE: A Parameterized GitHub Corpus Builder for Software Engineering Research
title_zh: SIEVE：面向软件工程研究的参数化GitHub语料库构建工具

paragraphs.en: 总结：SIEVE是一个开源参数化GitHub语料库构建工具，可在函数与类粒度提取并标注代码，助力软件工程研究与LLM评估。 Software engineering research increasingly relies on large, richly annotated corpora of real-world code. Still, researchers typically assemble these with ad-hoc scripts or static, pre-built datasets that offer no control over corpus composition. This leaves a gap for a reusable tool that goes below the repository level and builds annotated, function- and class-level code corpora under researcher-specified criteria. We present SIEVE (Software Ingestion & Extraction for Verifiable Evaluation), an open-source, parameterized GitHub corpus builder that, unlike repository-level mining tools, works at code granularity: it locates individual functions, methods, and classes in repositories and extracts them as records, giving direct control over corpus construction based on several criteria, including widely used programming languages (Python, Java, JavaScript, C++), repository quality, and creation date. To support software engineering research and LLM evaluation on real-world code, SIEVE extracts CodeSearchNet- and OpenClassGen-compatible records, each annotated with 22 structural metrics and AST-derived features, and optionally with a CodeBERT-based P(AI-generated) score (F1=0.9478, AUROC=0.9902), alongside the third-party dependencies declared in each repository's package manifest. These annotations enable researchers to conduct structural analyses, investigate code dependencies, assess AI-generated code, and construct customized benchmarks for evaluating LLMs, including under temporal constraints. A manual validation of 400 records in four languages and two granularities shows 100% accuracy in code metrics and import detection, 99.0% in source completeness, and 99.5% in metadata accuracy. SIEVE is publicly available with a live demo at https://mrahman2025-sieve.hf.space.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：SIEVE是一个开源参数化GitHub语料库构建工具，可在函数与类粒度提取并标注代码，助力软件工程研究与LLM评估。软件工程研究日益依赖大规模、注释丰富的真实世界代码语料库。 尽管如此，研究人员通常仍需借助临时脚本或静态的预构建数据集来组装这些语料库，无法控制语料库的构成。 这留下了一个空白：缺少一种可复用的工具，能够在仓库层级以下、按照研究人员指定的标准构建带标注的函数级与类级代码语料库。 我们提出了SIEVE（Software Ingestion & Extraction for Verifiable Evaluation），这是一个开源、参数化的GitHub语料库构建工具；与仓库级挖掘工具不同，它在代码粒度上工作：它在仓库中定位单个函数、方法和类，并将其提取为记录，从而可以基于多项标准直接控制语料库的构建，这些标准包括广泛使用的编程语言（Python、Java、JavaScript、C++）、仓库质量以及创建日期。 为支持软件工程研究和基于真实世界代码的LLM评估，SIEVE提取与CodeSearchNet和OpenClassGen兼容的记录，每条记录都标注了22项结构化指标和AST衍生特征，并可选择附加基于CodeBERT的P(AI-generated)分数（F1=0.9478，AUROC=0.9902），同时附带每个仓库在其包清单中声明的第三方依赖。 这些标注使研究人员能够进行结构分析、调查代码依赖、评估AI生成的代码，并构建用于评估LLM的定制化基准，包括在时间约束条件下的评估。 对四种语言、两种粒度共400条记录的人工验证显示，代码指标和导入检测的准确率为100%，源代码完整性的准确率为99.0%，元数据准确率为99.5%。 SIEVE已公开发布，并提供在线演示：https://mrahman2025-sieve.hf.space。
